notes.content:
「Main Story II - Endless Corridor」Update:
•「i」by Ωμεγα [Original]

Fix & Update
1. Added dark-themed UI, freely switchable in Settings.
2. New character "Lan" added: Unlocked after completing "Main Story II - Endless Corridor".
3. New outfit "Note - Futoko" added: Can be purchased with candy.
4. Adjusted Rating system and adjusted Nrk algorithm (Nrk will decrease differently after update).
5. Reduced candy acquisition penalty: When holding over 20,000 Candy, every additional 1,000 Candy reduces acquisition rate by 1%. The maximum penalty is 80%, when owning 100,000 Candy.
6. Changed character selection logic:
   - Tap character to cycle through permanent outfits
   - Tap blank area to confirm current outfit
   - Locked characters/outfits shows unlock prompt when tapping blank area
7. Slightly decreased candy drops during gameplay; slightly increased avatar drop rate.
8. Added new song pack covers for some chapters.
9. Fixed abnormal max fps on mobile under certain conditions.
10. Optimized resolution settings.
11. Fixed other issues.

Version-Only Event
1. "Nota - Radiant Negative" Rerun:
   - Available during v2.5 after clearing Main Story II
   - Unlock with 10,000 Candy (never available again after v2.5
2. "Note - Futoko" 50% Discount:
   - During v2.5, unlock for 6,000 Candy after getting original Note.
   - Price reverts to 12,000 Candy after the event.
3. Double Candy for 10 first plays daily during v2.5.
4. First Play Bonus: Extra Candy for first plays of any song during v2.5.
5. Login Reward:
   - 2,000 Candy for all players during v2.5
   - Additional 10,000 Candy for players on platforms where v2.0 was inaccessible.

notes.title: Update Log v2.0.8
notes.content:
update log v2.0.8

1. Fixed issues with transparency and color in certain charts. 
2. Fixed the problems which anti-aliasing level and rendering precision in setting had no effect.
3.Optimized the UI logic of the song selection difficulty tabs — tabs for unavailable difficulties will no longer be displayed.
4. Adjusted the descriptions for certain unlock conditions.
5. Fixed an issue where Nrk would display abnormally in certain situations.
6. Adjusted the recording mechanism for best play results.
7. Added new settings for adjusting note size and note speed. Note: Using non-default values may cause unexpected chart issues. We will not be responsible for any problems arising from this.
8. Milthm collaboration character "Luvia" is now unlockable: Achieve a Full Combo on any song in the collaboration chapter to obtain the key item.

notes.title: v2.0.0 Update Log
notes.content:
v2.0.0 Update Log
1. Redesigned the UI of the vast majority of interfaces, adjusted or remake the interaction logic and animations of all interfaces.
2. Notanote x Milthm Second Collaboration Update:
    •「Meltovt Necrosys」by Halv 
•「Elsorhg」by Fl00t 
•「Broken Conviction 」by Cansol
•「Vestige of Dreams 」by DRIVE. 
At the same time, the collaboration characters "Kino" and "Luvia" will join Notanote. You can change these characters for display and interaction in the main interface ("Luvia" is currently not available for unlocking. Please wait for the further version).
3. Notanote x Soul Notes Second Collaboration & First Anniversary Song Update:
• "Last Season" by lunari.io
• "Aether Ingita!" by ZAWA
• "Meltovt Necrosys (Salty Salt Remix)" by Salty Salt
• "Meltovt Necrosys (UraniumW Remix)" by UraniumW feat. ZAWA
4. Notanote x Orzmic Collaboration Addition: A new SP chart has been added for the track "Le Porteur d'Ombre".
5. Version Only Event:
    In v2.0, after completing "Side Story One - Fireworks Summer", players can obtain the Notanote limited costume "Notanote - Luminous Negative". Players who have already completed this storyline in previous versions can directly obtain it upon logging in.
    In v2.0, players will receive double candy drops for their first ten plays. Players who update to v2.0 will receive 2000 candies.
6. A new main game interface has been added. In the main interface, players can choose different characters or costumes for display and interaction, and can click different buttons to navigate to corresponding interfaces.
7. The chapter structure has been reset. Currently, it is divided into three song packs: "Story Mode", "Collaboration", and "Single Songs". Each pack contains multiple chapters, and each chapter includes corresponding songs. A new "All Songs" chapter has been added, where all songs can be viewed.
8. A new "FC/AP Indicator" function has been added, which can be enabled in the settings.
9. The end screen now includes a list of dropped items, floating play accuracy, and first-play display.
10. The calculation formula for Nrk has been reset, and the difficulty ratings for all charts have been adjusted. The rating rules have also been changed.
11. The candy drop mechanism and quantity have been modified, and the scoring system has been updated. The amount of candies required to unlock songs has been increased.
12. The level system and Tips system have been removed.
13. The hotkey system for PC has been optimized.
14. The difficulty name "EX" (Extra) has been changed to "TL" (Tale). Some "EZ" difficulty charts have been reset, and "EZ" difficulty charts have been added for some songs.
15. Issues with abnormal resolution display under special circumstances have been fixed, and game performance has been optimized.
